scalars.scalar_value: Demonstrated experience and skill using soldering iron or wire-wrapping tools to assemble electronic circuits from circuit diagrams.
Experience working at sea on oceanographic research vessels or similar field work.
Days, 8 when onsite. Variable when out at sea, Mon-Fri when onsite. Variable when out at sea

items.item_text: Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.
Must be willing and able to participate on research cruises of up to 3 months duration, for a total of up to 6 months annually without restrictions, holidays and weekends included.
Must be able to travel globally without restriction.
Must be physically fit to carry out duties without causing undue risk to self and others.
Must possess or be able to obtain Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC).
Bachelor's degree in electronic or mechanical engineering or equivalent combination of related experience and education.
Experience working at sea on oceanographic research vessels or similar field work.
Demonstrated experience and skill using soldering iron or wire-wrapping tools to assemble electronic circuits from circuit diagrams.
Demonstrated experience working with oceanographic instrumentation systems used on research vessels, which includes safety aspects of operation.
Proven knowledge and experience using electronic test equipment for maintaining, troubleshooting, and calibrating electronic equipment.
Demonstrated proficiency using standard application software and computers, i.e. text editors, Microsoft Outlook Suite, databases, CAD packages, data analysis software, etc.
Working knowledge of engineering principles and methods in order to independently perform professional engineering design work of limited scope and complexity.
Demonstrated knowledge of ocean data collection theories and practices.
Working knowledge of oceanographic sample collection and analysis techniques.
Demonstrated ability to maintain detailed and accurate records including journal of laboratory and field work activity; ability to compose reports and prepare technical documents.

Ability to work in a collaborative manner, to assist in identifying any challenges or barriers. Must be able to interact and work cooperatively with a wide variety of people, representing the institution and the university when participating in national and international research projects.
Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
